scope: User-requested ratio check, four milestones, existing TTC TSP citations and policy-weight decision; no new demand forecast or detailed construction schedule.
source_locator: February 2020 IBC, physical p.79 / printed p.71, Table 19, Option 1; assumptions physical p.78 / printed p.70
reference_option: Option 1, mostly at-grade Toronto alignment plus airport segment; not the selected final underground project or a Finch East budget
reference_cost_unit: CAD million, year-of-expenditure; ratios only, no price conversion
reconciliation_basis: Published component rows sum to 2933M versus reported total 2935M. Retain 2M as an unresolved table reconciliation; rounding is plausible but not officially confirmed.
exclusion_basis: Remove the entire separately reported professional-services allowance as a declared proxy for case-excluded consulting. It is not an audited consultant-only reconciliation; indirect costs may retain unidentified fee elements.
ratio_application: Normalize remaining template to reported total minus professional services, preserving the published rounding difference. Allocate INSIDE user totals CAD350M/CAD950M; do not add these categories on top or treat the result as an independently established total capital estimate.
other_bucket: Other capital / indirect / tax / rounding reconciliation; includes guideway, stops, MSF and sitework. Not an unallocated extra cost or certified consultant-free subtotal.
transfer_limitations: The source assumes private property acquisition only on the airport segment. Its low land share does not establish Finch East property needs.
Applying one LRT composition to BRT is a user-requested cross-technology approximation, not observed BRT composition.
A dimensionless ratio transfer does not solve total cost scope, price year or site feasibility; user cost levels remain hypothetical.

milestones.contained_scope: Planning/approval plus staged design and procurement decisions; operator and depot strategy identified.
Property access, utility relocation and access/ROW enabling works; unresolved sites remain delivery risks.
Civil works, stops, systems and depot/access delivery; fleet procurement/manufacture must complete within this period, not create an uncounted fifth phase.
Integration, safety/acceptance, trial running and operational readiness before opening.

milestone_basis: User stage-duration assumptions; calendar shows the sequential upper-envelope case of 2+2+4+1=9 years. Not a source forecast, critical-path model or engineering certification; no extra delay buffer in the upper case.
overlap_treatment: Keep the existing E=R/C formula and explicitly disclose its overlap with R. Policy-weight scenarios express alternative values; they do not mathematically remove shared information.
